text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Aoi Stakes. Once again 
today, Yamanin Zephyr feels a stirring in 
her ears. And then, she realizes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In a world where only her own wind had 
once blown, other winds had now begun to 
blow as well. The world across which she 
was meant to sweep had expanded.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow is the Japanese Derby, where 
Tokai Teio will run. Anticipating her 
victory, she fired herself up to deliver a 
performance that would surpass even that.
